notes:
Fifth release candidate for 2.2.0, for playtesting. Foundry v14, PF2e or SF2e.

Everything in rc.4, plus:

Faction leaders outrank their troops

Every named faction leader is now a higher level than the strongest troop their faction fields. To give them room, the factions gained higher-tier troops: Blood Pack Battlemaster (7) and Warlord (9), Blue Suns Captain (6) and Commander (8), Eclipse Commando (7) and Captain (8), and Quarian Commando (6). Leaders were rebuilt at their new levels: Garm 12, Vido Santiago 11, Ganar Wrang 10, Jona Sederis 10, Tarak, Jaroth and Wasea 9, the Quarian admirals 8–9, Commander Bailey 7. Saren goes from 9 to 13, above the Geth Prime.

35 new characters

Each has art and a token, and uses the module's own weapons, armor, shields and NPC powers.

  • Squadmates (Companions): Ashley Williams, Kaidan Alenko, Zaeed Massani, Kasumi Goto, Jacob Taylor, EDI, Javik.
  • Villains and bosses: Matriarch Benezia, the Shadow Broker, Morinth, Fist, Balak, Okeer, Maelon Heplorn, Doctor Saleon, Oleg Petrovsky, Henry Lawson, Nassana Dantius, Donovan Hock, Elnora, Lord Darius.
  • Allies and figures: Joker, Dr. Karin Chakwas, Urdnot Wreav, Urdnot Bakara, Primarch Victus, Executor Pallin, Kal'Reegar, Feron, Helena Blake, Dalatrass Linron, Matriarch Lidanya, Khalisah al-Jilani, Emily Wong, Gianna Parasini.

Sovereign

ME Ships → Sovereign, a level 21 Reaper above the Destiny Ascension: a 1,000-point barrier, an Indoctrination aura, and an Avatar link that drops its barriers when its avatar falls.

Tech powers for NPCs

Full details in the release notes.
